message.content:
It’s hard to pin down a single “best” film from 2020 because tastes vary so much, but one title that consistently topped critics’ lists and audience polls was **“The Trial of the Chicago 7.”**  
Directed by Aaron Sorkin, the film blends sharp dialogue, strong performances (especially from Sacha Baron Cohen, Eddie Redmayne, and Yahya Abdul-Mateen II), and a timely political narrative that resonated with viewers worldwide. It earned multiple Oscar nominations—including Best Picture—and won the Golden Globe for Best Motion Picture – Drama.  

If you’re looking for a standout 2020 release, “The Trial of the Chicago 7” is a great place to start.
